title: Nexus RunAcceptResponse
description: Response for POST /v1/daemon/compute/runs/{run_id}/accept — result of atomically applying a Run's proposals (V1.147 P0 direct lane).

state_delta_count.description: Number of state delta operations applied to existing KnowledgeEntries.

new_entries_created.description: Number of new KnowledgeEntry records created from new_key_blocks.

applied.description: Summary counts of what was applied in the atomic transaction.

timeline_event_ids.description: IDs of the Timeline events created during accept, in the order they were appended.
